A MESSAGE FROM A MESSAGE FROM THE YMCAs 
THE YMCAs of QUEBEC OF QUEBEC FOUNDATION 


The YMCA Helping all 


and yOu young people 
ea |. SUCTECT 


By supporting the YMCAs of Québec, you are 
contributing your expertise, time and funds to 
an organization that offers activities and services 
in a variety of areas, including health and active 
living, youth development, inclusion and social 
cohesion. 


Children and youth today are faced with complex 
challenges, and they don't all have access to the same 
opportunities to develop and thrive. 


At the YMCAs of Québec Foundation, we believe in 
equal opportunity. We want to provide all young people 
with experiences that will have a positive impact on their 
lives, regardless of their family or financial situation. We 
help youth adopt healthy lifestyle habits, grow and 
The YMCA is: have a greater sense of belonging and engagement to 
their community. 


With your help, the YMCA is able to provide 
everyone with opportunities to grow and be 
healthy in a welcoming and inclusive 
environment. 


+ a family of people who share common 


irations, id d values; oe : : 
er By believing in, talking about and supporting 


our mission, you are helping us reach more 
young people in more communities. 


+ aplace where you can give back to others 
and feel useful; 


* aplace which shows you that things can 
be different. Every day, your invaluable contributions help build 

a better future for our youth. Thank you! 

Many thanks to all the friends of the 

YMCA, be they employees, volunteers, 

members, donors or partners. 
Gregory Chrispin

Just like you, we strive for strong, healthy and vibrant communities 
where people come together, get involved and embrace diversity. 


A real hub of community life, the YMCA is a place that welcomes 
everyone. Through our services, we aim to create a greater sense of 
community and engagement. 


Every day, via our programs and facilities, our outreach workers welcome 
and support newcomers, lend a hand to the homeless, help people with 
criminal records lead a stable life, assist families with their children’s 
education and improve the lives of seniors. 


By providing seniors with a safe, friendly and stimulating 
meeting place, we help reduce their isolation. 


Mission 


The YMCAs of Québec Foundation supports 
the YMCAs of Québec and ensures its 
sustainability by promoting the impact of its 
community action, raising the funds to support 
it and administering these funds responsibly. 


Once again, hundreds 
of you supported YMCA youth: 


A final tribute 
to a great man 


A respected economist and 

strategic advisor, Marcel Cété 
demonstrated his incredible 
dedication to the YMCA for nearly half 
a century. Former President of the 
YMCAs of Québec Foundation, Marcel 
Cété was also Chair of the Circle of 
Mentors. He continues to build a 
strong future for children and youth 
from our communities through his 
contribution to the YMCA’s 


Endowment Fund. Thank you, Marcel.
